title: Welder Estimate Template
subtitle: A professional estimate pre-filled for welding jobs — MIG and TIG labor, materials, mobilization, repairs and custom fabrication. Download as Excel (auto-calculating), Word, or PDF.
taxHint: Look up your state's sales tax rate
paymentTerms: Net 10 — payment due within 10 days of acceptance. Workmanship guaranteed for 90 days on welded joints.
notes: Thank you for your business. Estimate valid for 30 days. A 50% deposit is due at signing for custom fabrication; the balance is due upon completion.
features: Auto-calculating totals in Excel — subtotal, 50% deposit and balance update automatically
Pre-filled welding line items: MIG/TIG labor, materials, mobilization, fabrication
Valid-until and deposit line built in — standard for fabrication quotes
Separate labor and materials lines keep estimates transparent

faqs.q: What should I include on a welder estimate?
faqs.a: At minimum: your business name, the client and job site, dated line items (labor by type, materials, mobilization), a valid-until date, deposit terms and exclusions. Note the weld standard you will follow and your workmanship guarantee.

faqs.q: Is this template free to use?
faqs.a: Yes. All three formats (PDF, Word, Excel) are free to download with no email required.

faqs.q: Does the Excel version calculate the deposit and balance automatically?
faqs.a: Yes. Enter your quantity and rate per line, and the subtotal, 50% deposit and balance due update automatically.

faqs.q: Is this legal or tax advice?
faqs.a: No. Templates are for informational purposes only. Requirements vary by state — verify with your licensing authority and a CPA or attorney before use.
